quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia press release: RNP selects Nokia and Q13 to modernize Brazil's research (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer RNP (Rede Nacional de Ensino e Pesquisa, Brazil's national research and education network) selected Nokia and Q13 to modernize rede Ipe as a new secure, automated, high-performance IP network connecting more than four million users. The deployment will deliver 4.8 Tbps of aggregate capacity across more than 350 routers, a scalable IP backbone ready to evolve to 800G; Nokia will provide core, aggregation, peering and universal provider edge capabilities using its 7750 Service Router and 7250 Interconnect Router platforms, and Q13 will lead implementation and migration. Per RNP, it will for the first time have core, aggregation, peering and edge equipment from a single technology provider.
